# Kana

> Kana (카나) is a paid macOS app: an anime character who lives on your Mac desktop and runs real errands through Claude Code — mail, calendar, files and the web — and stops to ask before anything is sent, paid or deleted. Made by Chanjun Kwon, a designer in Korea. Released 2026-11-27.

Kana is not a desktop pet that only shows status, and not a chat window you open: she stays on the desktop, you hand her a task in a speech bubble, and she reports back in one line. Outward-facing actions wait on an approval card.

## Key facts
- Platform: macOS 13 or later, Apple silicon (M1 or newer). Windows version in progress (no date).
- Brain: your own Anthropic API key (recommended) or a Claude Code sign-in. AI usage is billed to your Anthropic account, separately from Kana's price.
- Price: US$19.00 launch price (regular US$24.00), one-time purchase, no subscription. Up to 3 Macs per license key. All 1.x updates included. 13 outfits.
- No free trial. Full refund within 14 days, no questions asked. Payment by Polar.
- Languages: Korean and English.
- Privacy: Kana has no server of its own; requests go from your Mac straight to your Anthropic account.
- Safety: sending, paying and deleting always stop at an approval card first.
